scripts.pack:check: bun pm pack --cwd packages/sdk --dry-run && bun pm pack --cwd packages/cli --dry-run && bun run test:package
scripts.publish:cli: bun run build && bun publish --cwd packages/cli --access public --tag latest
scripts.publish:sdk: bun run build && bun publish --cwd packages/sdk --access public --tag latest
scripts.release:check: bun run release:preflight && bun run test && bun run pack:check
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc --project tsconfig.memory-chain.json --noEmit && bun run --cwd packages/mcp-server typecheck:mcp
scripts.test:unit: vitest run && bun run --cwd packages/mcp-server test:mcp && bun run test:codex
scripts.test:smoke: bun scripts/smoke.ts && bun run --cwd packages/mcp-server smoke
scripts.test: bun run docs:check && bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test:unit && bun run build && bun run test:smoke
